==Description==
The '''Jaxe''' was the narrator for the [[Rotfield]] map. It was the [[Jaxe (Solar Eclipse)|Jaxe]] from the [[Solar Eclipse Event]].

==Appearance==
The '''Jaxe''' had green skin and an orange pumpkin head with a scar on its left eye. The pumpkin had a yellow glow inside of it. It wore a black cape, grey chestplate, shoulderpads and kneepads. It also had black wristbands and orange armbands on both of its arms. It also had a large axe, present in most of its icons.
